text: This report requests that the Toronto and East York Community Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately-owned tree located at 233 Dunvegan Road. The applicant indicates the reason for requesting the removal of the tree due to concern over large falling nuts. The black walnut tree (Juglans nigra) measures 85cm in diameter. The City's Tree By-laws do not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable. The permit was denied, and the applicant is appealing the decision. The Community Council has delegated authority from the City Council to make a final decision as to whether a permit may be issued when an applicant appeals the City's decision to deny a tree permit.
The Toronto and East York Community Council took no action on this Item.
